_comment: Copy this file to llm_config.local.json and fill in your API key. The .local.json file is gitignored. Env overrides: MEMORY_LLM_API_KEY / MEMORY_LLM_BASE_URL / MEMORY_LLM_MODEL / MEMORY_LLM_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS / MEMORY_LLM_MAX_TOTAL_OUTPUT_TOKENS / MEMORY_LLM_MAX_INPUT_TOKENS / MEMORY_LLM_INPUT_CNY_PER_MTOK / MEMORY_LLM_OUTPUT_CNY_PER_MTOK / MEMORY_LLM_MAX_TOTAL_COST_CNY / MEMORY_LLM_DEFAULT_THINKING / MEMORY_LLM_DEFAULT_REASONING_EFFORT.
_cost_controls: Per-call output cap (clamps max_tokens). Reference: deepseek-v4-flash output ~2 yuan/1M tokens, so 1024 tokens ~= 0.002 yuan/call.
_total_budget: Soft per-process cumulative completion-tokens budget. Set 0 to disable. 200000 tokens ~= 0.4 yuan on flash, ~5 yuan on pro.
_input_cap: Per-call input cap (estimated tokens). Bounds prompt size for input-side billing. Set 0 to disable.
_pricing: CNY per 1M tokens. deepseek-v4-flash: 1 input / 2 output. deepseek-v4-pro: 12 input / 24 output. Used for usage_snapshot cost estimate and max_total_cost_cny budget.
_total_cost_budget: Soft per-process cumulative cost cap in CNY. 0 disables.
_thinking: Default reasoning mode. Off saves cost. When enabled, choose effort: low / medium / high.
